```
private static boolean isInternetConnectivityValidated(ConnectivityManager connectivityManager){
  if (connectivityManager == null) {
    return false;
  }
  if (Util.SDK_INT < 24) {
    return true;
  }
  @Nullable Network activeNetwork=connectivityManager.getActiveNetwork();
  if (activeNetwork == null) {
    return false;
  }
  @Nullable NetworkCapabilities networkCapabilities=connectivityManager.getNetworkCapabilities(activeNetwork);
  return networkCapabilities != null && networkCapabilities.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_VALIDATED);
}
```

2. 潜在运行时异常分析：
   - connectivityManager.getActiveNetwork() 和 getNetworkCapabilities() 方法可能抛出NullPointerException

   - 但代码中已经对activeNetwork进行了null检查
   - 主要风险在于connectivityManager参数本身可能为null

   - 如果connectivityManager为null，调用其方法会抛出NullPointerException
